description: Source-faithful Rain icon assets with confirmed scene selection and host-owned color.
useWhen: An existing Rain asset matches the actual action or information role
doNotUseWhen: Inferring new global semantics from a name alone

props.size: host size or explicit CSS width
props.label: optional accessible information label

layoutConstraints: 24x24 source canvas; host owns display size
Supplemental grading rings retain their 12x12 canvas; the host supplies the backing surface.
compositionRules: Host owns actions, color, motion, disabled state and focus
antiPatterns: Full catalog import for one static icon

retainedTraits: Geometry, canvas, alpha, fixed palette and confirmed semantics
redesignedTraits: React static entry and isolated image renderer

migrationNotes: Complete source identities retained; source failures remain unavailable and are never silently replaced.
